title.narrative: Förderung einer ganzheitlichen Ökologie in den Gemeinden in Kolumbien
Promoting holistic ecology in communities in Colombia

description.narrative: Conventional subsistence agriculture and livestock farming dominate the area. The communities are located far from urban centres, which increases the cost of inputs and makes it difficult to market their products. Conventional practices have degraded local ecosystems and led to a loss of biodiversity, a decline in water quantity and quality, and soil degradation. The presence of armed groups restricts access to certain areas and has exacerbated conflicts over the use of natural resources.
